title: Picking Lists (forklift work orders, v1)
description: A plant's picking lists: ordered work orders for the forklift simulation (see specs.md §5.3). The third file of a plant, alongside its plan (warehouse.schema.json, whose `id` this file references as `warehouseId`) and its content (warehouse.content.schema.json). Loaded independently of both. The forklift starts and ends every list at the plan's first lift station without it being listed. A stop naming a location the plan doesn't have is skipped when the route is built.

warehouseId.description: The warehouse.schema.json plan's `id` these lists were written for.

mode.description: picking: a slot stop removes one pallet, a depot stop delivers everything held. storing: a depot stop loads as many pallets as the slot stops following it need (at most 3), and each slot stop stores one.

id.description: A slot id (kind "slot"), or a lift station / delivery space id (kind "depot").
